title: THE RUN GOALS ARE THE PARTY
why: His order of 2026-10-14: the raid flow batch must work for both players. Each window drew its own three run goals and counted its own kills, crates and strikes, so the two lists drifted apart and a goal one player finished paid its chip twice. The host now owns the goals: it says the three goals and how far each is in the world word, player 2 shows exactly those and says GOAL DONE when one is met, and he counts and pays nothing of his own. What counts is the party: player 2 kills reach the goals, his air strike counts for AIR STRIKE, and his kill of the bounty pillager claims the bounty. The goals are also in the hold Alt raid status now, one tile each, with the figure or DONE.
now: The run goals are now shared by both players, and they show in the hold Alt raid status.
